SAFETY FIRST

Tazvera Shield checks every send.

  • Look-alike addresses: scammers copy the first and last letters. Shield spots the trick and stops the send.
  • Wrong places: burn and token-contract addresses are blocked, so coins are not lost.
  • Your 12 words never leave your phone. Tazvera never asks for them. Anyone who does is a scammer.
  • Big amounts get a second check: before a large payment, Shield asks you to check once more.

FAQ

Common questions

Is Tazvera free?

Yes. The app is free and open source. When you send, you only pay the small network fee to the blockchain. Tazvera takes nothing.

Who holds my keys?

Only you. Your keys are made on your phone and locked with your PIN. We never see them and can never move your money.

What if I lose my phone?

Open app.tazvera.com on a new phone, choose "Import wallet", type your 12 secret words and set a new PIN. Without the 12 words, no one can bring the wallet back, not even us.

Is TZV for sale?

No. TZV has no sale and no presale. It is given as rewards to users and developers. Anyone selling "Tazvera" coins is a scammer.

Which networks does it support?

Shardeum Mainnet for real payments, plus free test networks (Shardeum Testnet, BNB Chain Testnet, Ethereum Sepolia) to practise with test coins that have no value.

How do I report a scam or a bug?

Email contact@tazvera.com. For security problems, follow our Security policy on GitHub. Valid, first reports can earn TZV.
